title: krot-control chart values
description: Validated against the krot-control chart templates. Keys the templates interpolate verbatim are restricted to what renders into a valid manifest; the config map is a passthrough and is not validated beyond being a string map.

quantity.description: Kubernetes resource quantity: a number or a string with an optional suffix (m, Mi, Gi, ...).

stringMap.description: String-to-string map, as required by Kubernetes labels and annotations.

repository.description: Image repository. An empty one renders `image: ":<tag>"`, which the kubelet refuses with InvalidImageName.

tag.description: Rendered verbatim after the ':' separator; empty falls back to .Chart.AppVersion, which is why it may be empty here.

secretName.description: Out-of-band Secret consumed with envFrom alongside the ConfigMap. The key is required; an empty name is refused by the template, because it renders a secretRef the API server refuses.

host.description: Ingress rule host. Required whenever the Ingress renders: an empty host renders a rule the API server refuses.

tlsSecret.description: TLS secret name; empty renders the Ingress without a tls block.

config.description: Non-secret environment, rendered verbatim into the krot-cp-config ConfigMap. Keys become environment variable names, so they have to be names Kubernetes accepts.
